lines.japanese: 結局、吉川さんと一緒に三人で夕方までだらだら過ごしてしまった。
lines.english: In the end, the three of us lazed around with Yoshikawa until evening.

lines.japanese: 二人でテストの話なんてしてるから、つい横からちょこちょこ口を出してしまった。そのせいで二方向から尊敬の眼差しみたいなものを向けられて、俺は調子に乗った。
lines.english: The two girls started talking about a test, and I couldn't resist tossing in a comment here and there. Then they both looked at me with something like admiration, and it went straight to my head.

lines.japanese: ああ楽しかったなあ。
lines.english: Ah, that had been fun.

lines.japanese: それだけにこれから行く先を考えるとうんざりする。今度は俺がちょこちょこ口を出される側だ。
lines.english: Which made it all the more depressing to think where I was headed now. This time, I would be the one having comments tossed in from the sidelines.

lines.japanese: しかも尊敬の眼差しを向ける気にはなれない。それどころか、やつらは俺のことを上から目線で見てくる連中だ。
lines.english: And I had no intention of looking at them with admiration. These were people who made a point of looking down on me.

lines.japanese: ああげんなりするなあ。自然と足も遅くなる。
lines.english: God, what a drag. My feet slowed all on their own.

lines.japanese: 俺は早めに家を出はしたものの、目的もなく街中をぶらついた。
lines.english: I had left home early, but I wandered aimlessly through town.

lines.japanese: なんだ、今日はパルさんいないんだ。
lines.english: Huh. Paru wasn't here today.

lines.japanese: なんとなく、あの気風のいい笑い声で嫌な気分を吹きとばして欲しかったけど、居ないんなら仕方ないや。
lines.english: Some part of me had hoped that big, openhearted laugh of hers would blow my foul mood away. But if she wasn't here, she wasn't here.

lines.japanese: 手持ち無沙汰になった俺は、いつもパルクレープが停まってる場所に落ちてたゴミや吸殻が気になったから、拾い集めてゴミ箱まで捨てにいった。
lines.english: At loose ends, I noticed the trash and cigarette butts around the spot where Paru Crêpes usually parked, so I gathered them up and carried them to a bin.

lines.japanese: 歩くたびにスポーツバックの中のヘルメットが腰骨に当たってさっきから痛い。
lines.english: Every step made the helmet in my sports bag knock against my hipbone. It had been hurting for a while now.

lines.japanese: パルクレープのないピンフ通りは、賑やかさに華がないな。俺は鞄を反対側の肩にかけて、この場所から離れようとした。
lines.english: Pinfu Street lacked a certain sparkle without Paru Crêpes. I switched the bag to my other shoulder and started away.

lines.japanese: 「あーッ！」
lines.english: “Ah!”

lines.japanese: 「へっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”
“G-grrrrrrr!”

lines.japanese: 「なんだ、なんだこの視床下部を刺激する甲高い唸り声は」
lines.english: “What is this shrill growl tickling my hypothalamus?”

lines.japanese: 「隼人君じゃーんっ！」
lines.english: “It's Hayatoooo!”

lines.japanese: 「なんだ、香田か」
lines.english: “Oh. Koda.”

lines.japanese: 俺は路傍の石に目もくれず、先を急いだ。
lines.english: I ignored her like a pebble by the roadside and quickened my pace.

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、待って！　なーん、なんで逃げるん！」
lines.english: “H-hey, wait! Whyyy? Why're you running away?”

lines.japanese: だが高速で駆けよってきた香田に立ちふさがられた。
lines.english: But Koda came pelting after me at tremendous speed and planted herself in my path.

lines.japanese: 「おいおい失礼なことを言うな。ちょっと急いでただけだ」
lines.english: “Come on, don't be rude. I'm just in a hurry.”

lines.japanese: 「腿あげ運動しっ放しじゃん！　なに、そんな急いでどこ行くん」
lines.english: “You're doing high knees in place! What's the rush? Where're you going?”
“...Work?”

lines.japanese: 「いや聞いてるの私。なに、仕事なん？」
lines.english: “I'm asking *you*. What, you got work?”

lines.japanese: 嘘は言ってないが急いでいる理由かと聞かれるとちょっと違う。避けたりするつもりはないけど、香田とは微妙な別れ際のままだったから絡みにくい。ブッ殺すぞ成田隼人。
lines.english: It wasn't a lie, but it wasn't exactly why I was hurrying either. I wasn't trying to avoid Koda. It was simply hard to know how to act around her after the awkward way we had parted. I'll fucking kill you, Hayato Narita.

lines.japanese: 「あ、じゃあ現場まで付いてっていい？」
lines.english: “Oh! Then can I come with you to the site?”

lines.japanese: 「いやいや、それはいかん」
lines.english: “No, no. Absolutely not.”

lines.japanese: さすがに公私のけじめは付けないとな。仕方ない、適当に相手をしてお引取り願うか。
lines.english: I did have to draw a line between work and my private life. Fine. I would humor her for a minute, then persuade her to be on her way.

lines.japanese: 「仕方ない、寝る暇がないほど忙しい俺だが、おまえのために少しだけ時間を割いてやろう。で、なんの用だ」
lines.english: “Very well. Though I am a man so busy he has no time for sleep, I shall spare you a moment. What do you want?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、聞いてよ！　富士山って日本で一番高い山じゃん？　じゃあ二番目ってなにか知ってる？　私今日授業で知って初シリなんだけどマジ知りたくない？」
lines.english: “Oh, listen! Mount Fuji's the tallest mountain in Japan, right? Know what's second? I learned it in class today—first I'd ever heard of it. Don't you seriously wanna know?”

lines.japanese: 「いいんだな、少ししか時間割かないのにその話でいいんだな」
lines.english: “You do understand that I'm giving you only a moment, and this is how you want to spend it?”

lines.japanese: 「ん、ちょっと待て。おまえ学校行ってんのか」
lines.english: “Wait a minute. You go to school?”

lines.japanese: そういえばこの前会ったときに制服着てたよな。あれ、この制服、誰か別のやつが着てるのも見たような気がする。
lines.english: Come to think of it, she had been in uniform the last time we met. Hm? I had a feeling I'd seen somebody else wearing that uniform too.

lines.japanese: 「え、だって隼人君が本気で心配してるから学校行けってゆったんじゃん」
lines.english: “What? You're the one who got all seriously worried and told me to go to school, Hayato.”
“I did?”

lines.japanese: 俺そんなこと言ったか？
lines.english: Had I really said that?

lines.japanese: 「あーでも、今まで勉強してなかったし、クラスに友達もいないし、ザセツ覚えそうなんだよね。はー、気分下々↓↓サガるサガる」
lines.english: “But, like, I’d never studied before, and I don’t have friends in class. Feels like I’m about to get my first taste of failure. Ugh, my mood’s sinking ↓↓ Sinking fast.”

lines.japanese: 「ふーん」
lines.english: “Huh.”

lines.japanese: 珍しく落ちこんでる。まあそれも青春だ、がんばれ小娘。
lines.english: She was uncharacteristically down. Well, that was part of youth too. Hang in there, kid.

lines.japanese: 「ま、でも今日隼人君に会えたから元気出た！」
lines.english: “But hey, I got to see you today, so now I feel better!”

lines.japanese: と思ったらあっさり立ち直った。この前向きさは見習った方がいいかもしれない。
lines.english: And just like that, she bounced back. Perhaps I ought to learn something from her optimism.

lines.japanese: 「んで？　今からまだ時間あるの？　だったら、らぶらぶしよーよ」
lines.english: “So? You still got time? Then let’s go out.”

lines.japanese: 「だから急いでるって言ってんだろ、一分一秒を惜しんでるんだよ、スケジュールびっしりなんだよ。ぶらぶらなんてしてる暇……え、ぶらぶらじゃなくてらぶらぶ？」
lines.english: “I told you I’m in a hurry. Every second counts. My schedule’s packed. I don’t have time to go out wandering around... Hang on. You mean go out with you?”

lines.japanese: 「えへへ、現場までお見送りしますね」
lines.english: “Hee hee. I’ll walk you to the job site.”

lines.japanese: 「いやホント頼むから来ないでください。ぶらぶらの方なら妥協してもいいから」
lines.english: “No, seriously, please don’t come. I could settle for just wandering around.”

lines.japanese: 「え、妥協すんの？　ぶらぶらすんのはアリなん？」
lines.english: “Wait, you would? We can wander around?”

lines.japanese: 「まあしばらく会ってなかったしいいんじゃないか」
lines.english: “Well, we haven't seen each other in a while. Why not?”

lines.japanese: 「おおっ！」
lines.english: “Oh!”

lines.japanese: 「よーっし、じゃあダーツしに行くぞーっ！」
lines.english: “All riiight! Let's go play darts!”

lines.japanese: 「待て小娘、ダーツっておまえそれ、ぶらぶら通りこしてがっつり遊ぶ気満々だろ」
lines.english: “Hold it, kid. Darts? That’s well past wandering around. You’re planning a whole outing.”

lines.japanese: そのあと適当に何軒かはしごして仕事までの時間を潰した。
lines.english: After that, we hit a few places and killed time until work.

lines.japanese: 香田が現場まで付いてくる気満々だったので、土下座してお引きとり願った。とりあえず駅まで見送ると「また今度」と手を振っていたので、適当に相槌を打ってそこで別れた。
lines.english: Koda was dead set on following me to the job site, so I got down on my knees and begged her to go home. I walked her as far as the station. She waved and said, “See you next time,” and I gave her a noncommittal answer before we parted.

lines.japanese: 香田に会ったときは気まずかったけど、いつもと変わらないで接してくれたから助かった。
lines.english: Things had felt awkward when I first saw Koda, but she treated me exactly as she always had. That helped.

lines.japanese: 俺は肌が荒れるのが分かってたけど、乾いた唇を何度も舐めながら現場へと向かった。いや、なんとなくね。
lines.english: I knew it would only chap them worse, but I kept licking my dry lips as I headed for the site. No particular reason.

lines.japanese: ここに来るのも久しぶりだ。それでも現場に来ている人数と面子はさほど変わらない。１２月の気温の中、工事の具合はゆっくりと進む。
lines.english: It had been a while since I'd come here. Even so, the crew was much the same, in both number and membership. In the December cold, construction crept onward.

lines.japanese: ひと一人なんか知ったこっちゃないと作業を進める削岩機の横を抜け、唯一会話の成立する顔見知りの元へ急ぐ。
lines.english: I passed a jackhammer pounding ahead without the slightest concern for any one human life and hurried toward the only familiar face capable of conversation.

lines.japanese: 「あの、いいすか」
lines.english: “Uh, got a minute?”

lines.japanese: 「なんだ、おまえか。しばらく顔見せなかったな」
lines.english: “Oh, it's you. Haven't shown your face in a while.”

lines.japanese: 現場監督のおっさんは見取り図かなにかの紙面を広げつつ、でも俺に顔を向けてくれた。おっさんと話していた連中を含めて、他のやつらは格好からアルバイトの俺を鼻で笑うように眉を寄せて見ている。
lines.english: The old foreman had a blueprint or some such sheet spread before him, but he still turned to face me. The other men, including those who had been speaking with him, frowned at my clothes with the contempt reserved for a part-timer.

lines.japanese: 「ちっと体調崩してて」
lines.english: “Was feeling a little under the weather.”

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿、体で稼いでるんだったら体壊したからって文句言うな。そりゃおまえの勝手だろ」
lines.english: “Idiot. If your body earns your keep, don't complain to me when you wreck it. That's your own damn affair.”

lines.japanese: 別に文句なんて言ってない。でも会話は出来ても言葉が通じないのは分かってるから、俺はすんませんとだけ頷いた。
lines.english: I hadn't complained at all. But I already knew that being able to converse with him didn't mean we spoke the same language, so I only nodded and said, “Sorry.”

lines.japanese: 正直やりにくい。いくら統合した俺だと言っても、こういう現場でいつものおちゃらけをしてたら居場所がなくなる。
lines.english: Honestly, it was awkward. Integrated or not, if I started clowning around the way I usually did at a site like this, I would have no place here at all.

lines.japanese: 「来たってことは仕事やるんだろ。場所選んでくるから、その間に着替えて待ってろ」
lines.english: “You came, so you're here to work. I'll find somewhere to put you. Change and wait till I get back.”

lines.japanese: 「うっす！」
lines.english: “Yessir!”

lines.japanese: 「ああ？　いつも仏頂面しかしないのに、今日は愛想いいじゃねえか」
lines.english: “Huh? Usually all you do is scowl. You're mighty friendly today.”

lines.japanese: ヒゲのおっさんが少し驚いたように俺を見て黄色い歯を見せる。俺がやりにくいと分かっていつつこの現場に来たのは、この汚い顔が気に入ってるからなんだろう。
lines.english: The bearded old man looked at me with mild surprise, then flashed his yellow teeth. Maybe the reason I had come despite knowing how awkward this place would be was that I liked that filthy face of his.

lines.japanese: おっさんが事務所の方に向かったので、俺は柱の影でさっさと作業服に着替えた。
lines.english: The old man headed toward the office, and I quickly changed into my work clothes behind a pillar.

lines.japanese: 「おーい、やっぱりコンクリ来てねえってよ。休憩入んぞ」
lines.english: “Hey! Concrete still hasn't come. Break time.”

lines.japanese: 「まぁーた来てないんすかぁ？　あいつらホント使えないっすね」
lines.english: “Still not here? Those assholes are completely useless.”

lines.japanese: 「おーい、なんつったっけ、おまえバイト！　俺らちっと１０分ちょっと出かけンから、ラチェット出しとけ！」
lines.english: “Hey, you—part-timer, whatever your name is! We're heading out for ten minutes or so. Get the ratchet ready!”

lines.japanese: 「はいっ！」
lines.english: “Yes!”

lines.japanese: 元気よく返事をしたが届かなかった。連中は飛び入り一人残して、さっさと現場を空にしてしまった。
lines.english: I answered briskly, but they didn't hear. Leaving the one last-minute hire behind, the men promptly emptied the site.

lines.japanese: 「で、なにを出しとけって？」
lines.english: “So... what did they tell me to get out?”

lines.japanese: 弱った、よく聞こえなかったのもあるけど、どうしたもんか。用意しとかないとうるさそうだし。
lines.english: This was bad. Part of it was that I hadn't heard clearly, but either way, what was I supposed to do? They would raise hell if I didn't have it ready.

lines.japanese: 途方に暮れて立っていると、遠くから聞きおぼえのあるエンジン音が近づいてくるのが分かった。
lines.english: As I stood there helplessly, I heard a familiar engine approaching from far down the road.

lines.japanese: 徐々に音量を上げて近づいてくるそれは、確認しようと車道に出た俺に確信をもたらした。ズンズンと下品な低音を鳴らして白いワゴンがやってくる。
lines.english: The sound drew nearer and swelled until, the moment I stepped into the road for a look, I knew. A white van came rolling in with vulgar bass pounding *boom, boom*.

lines.japanese: それは誘導員の近くで停まり、運転席その他二箇所のドアの中から三人の男たちが降りてくる。
lines.english: It stopped near the traffic marshal, and three men climbed out from the driver's seat and two of the other doors.

lines.japanese: っていうか遠くから見ても一目で分かるシルエットだった。
lines.english: Not that I needed a closer look. Their silhouettes were unmistakable from a mile away.

lines.japanese: 「Ｕｍｍ……こんなギバラの果てまで来るとは思わなかったぜ、Ｅｈ？　ここに果たしてあの男がいるのやら、ククク。エイヨー、ワッツアップ成田クン！　この俺、左右田仙一ａｋａＬＲ２００１ただ今参上ォ！」
lines.english: “Umm... Never thought we'd come all the way to the ass end of Gibara, eh? Is the man we seek truly here? Heh heh. Ayo, what's up, Narita! Senichi Souda, a.k.a. LR2001, now arriving on the scene!”

lines.japanese: 「やー、も・間違いないッスよ！　ナオジから『成田君大発見！』の写メ入ってんし、あの特徴的なフォルムは一度見たら忘れないでしょー。隼人センパーイ！　バニィＤ、同じく参上ォ！」
lines.english: “Yeah—no doubt about it! Naoji sent us a phone pic saying, 'Hayato Narita: found!' And nobody forgets that distinctive form once they've seen it. Hayato! Banny D likewise arrives on the scene!”

lines.japanese: 「ぶはーっ！　ホントならお久しぶりぶりだよネェ？　オ～イ、チケドンさんが遊びに来たよォ～！　ほいだら、せーので呼んどきましょオ、いっせーの……成田っち～！　あっそびっま――」
lines.english: “Bwah! If it really is you, then long time no see-see, right? Heeey! Chikedon came to play! Okay, everybody call him on three. Ready, set... Naritaaa! Come out and plaaay—”

lines.japanese: 「せんっ」
lines.english: “—not.”

lines.japanese: 俺の蹴りが一閃、白いワゴンの扉に突き刺さった。一人挟まれた気がするけど、どうでもいい。
lines.english: I drove a single flashing kick into the white van's door. I had the impression somebody was caught between the door and the frame, but that was of no concern.

lines.japanese: 「いだっ！　いだだだだだ、ステイクール、待ってくれ成田君いだだだだだだ！　体に縦の線が、線がァッ！」
lines.english: “Ow! Owowowowow! Stay cool, Narita, wait! Owowowow! My body's got a line down the middle! A liiiine!”

lines.japanese: 「貴様らなにしに来た。場合によっちゃ徹底抗戦も覚悟しておけ」
lines.english: “What are you bastards doing here? Depending on your answer, prepare for total war.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょーちょーちょー、せっかく来たのになにピリッてんスか、隼人先～輩！　俺らあんたの顔を見に来ただけだって！」
lines.english: “Whoa, whoa, whoa! We came all this way—why you gotta get so heated, Hayato? We only came to see your face!”

lines.japanese: 「そーよ！　成田っちと会うの久しぶりでしょオ～！？　もっと広い心で受け止めてほしいよネ～」
lines.english: “Exactly! It's been forever since we saw you, right? Open your heart and let us in!”

lines.japanese: 「ヴァカたれ、この対応が俺のキャパシティギリギリだっつの。ぱじゅかしい真似すんな、帰れ帰れ」
lines.english: “You idjits, this is the absolute limit of my emotional capacity. Quit doing embawassing shit. Go home, go home.”

lines.japanese: 心優しい俺は体を半分だけ車の外に出していたハゲを解放してやった。
lines.english: Kind soul that I was, I released the bald man trapped halfway out of the van.

lines.japanese: 「ハハァ、ロスに居た頃と変わらねぇなァ！　全くイルなドックだあんたはァ、中を掻きまわしたくなっちまう」
lines.english: “Haha! Same as ever since your days in L.A.! You one ill dog, man. Makes me wanna stir up your insides!”

lines.japanese: 「そんな略称の土地に一分たりとも滞在した記憶はないっつの」
lines.english: “I don't remember spending so much as one minute in any place that goes by those initials.”

lines.japanese: 「あだだだだだだだ！　成田クン、イッツァ・ジョオォォォーク！　線がァァッ！」
lines.english: “Owowowowowow! Narita, it's a jooooook! The liiiine!”

lines.japanese: 「で、何しに来た？」
lines.english: “Why are you here?”

lines.japanese: 「だーから、そんなちょっせーこと言うなよォ！　俺らホントにあんたの顔見に来ただけだって！」
lines.english: “Come on, don’t be so stingy! We really did come just to see your face!”

lines.japanese: 「パカもん、ＴＰＯを弁えろ。見ろこの作業服にヘルメット、どこから見ても全力でお仕事真っ最中だろうが」
lines.english: “Morons. Learn to pick your time and place. Look at these work clothes and this helmet. I’m obviously in the middle of a shift.”

lines.japanese: 「いやだってネェ？　俺らだって、毎日成田っちのこと探してたのよ？　で～もあんたさァ、ここンとこぷっつり消息不明だったじゃん」
lines.english: “But listen, okay? We been looking for you every day. Then lately you just completely dropped off the map.”

lines.japanese: 「そうそう、もしかすっとォ、隼人先輩どっか拉致られたんじゃねえかぁ？とかぁ、とうとう下手やってムショ入ってんじゃねえか？とかぁ、色々心配してっとこ見つかったら、そりゃ駆けつけるでしょ」
lines.english: “Yeah! We were worried maybe you got kidnapped somewhere, or finally fucked up and landed in the slammer. Then somebody found you—course we'd come running.”

lines.japanese: 「へっ？　あ、心配……してたの？」
lines.english: “Huh? You were... worried about me?”

lines.japanese: 「だって成田っちは俺らの仲間みたいなもんじゃん」
lines.english: “You're practically one of the crew, Narita.”

lines.japanese: 「そうそう。俺らあんたがここにいるって連絡来るまで、ちょーどその話してたトコだったんスよ」
lines.english: “Yeah. We were just talking about you when the message came saying you were here.”

lines.japanese: 「お、おまえたち……」
lines.english: “You guys...”

lines.japanese: 俺は目頭が生ぬるくなるのを感じた。そうか、俺のことをそんな風に……。
lines.english: The corners of my eyes grew strangely warm. So that was how they felt about me...

lines.japanese: 「そんときワックなバーガーにケチャップが足りねえーって話もしたけどナー！　まったくあの店員だけは許せねェゼ、マザファッカ！」
lines.english: “We also talked about that wack burger not having enough ketchup, though! I'll never forgive that clerk, motherfucker!”

lines.japanese: 「ぎゃああああああ！」
lines.english: “Gyaaaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 「で、成田っちはこの一週間くらい？　何してたの～？」
lines.english: “So, Narita—what've you been doing this past week or so?”

lines.japanese: 「何してたって、普通に仕事してたに決まってるだろ」
lines.english: “What do you think? Working, obviously.”

lines.japanese: 「ええ～え！　そりゃありえないでしょ！　だって俺ら、この現場一日一回は見回りきてたもん」
lines.english: “Whaaat!? No way! We came by this site to check once every single day.”

lines.japanese: 「ウソォ！？」
lines.english: “Seriously!?”

lines.japanese: 「んで隼人先輩いねーっつって、がっかりしながら帰ってたんだって！　なぁなぁ、何しちゃってたのよォ～！」
lines.english: “And every day we went home all disappointed 'cause Hayato wasn't here! Come on, what've you been up to?”

lines.japanese: 「い、いや……その前におまえらが何してんのよ……」
lines.english: “N-no... Before that, what the hell have *you* been up to?”

lines.japanese: なんでだ。確かにこいつらとはなんだかんだで出くわしたり走り回ったりしたけど、そこまで懐かれる要素があるとは思えん。
lines.english: Why? True, I had run into these men and raced around with them often enough, but I couldn't imagine what I had done to inspire this degree of attachment.

lines.japanese: 「いやぶっちゃけ、なんでそこまで俺を追っかけるのかワカラン。バカやりたいならおまえら三人で充分だろ」
lines.english: “No, seriously. I don't get why you chase after me this hard. If all you want is to act like idiots, the three of you are plenty.”

lines.japanese: ガードレールに腰を下ろしながらややマジ気味なトーンで問いつめると、やつらにしては珍しく萎れた表情で項垂れた。
lines.english: I sat down on the guardrail and pressed them in a rare moment of seriousness. Unusually for these three, their faces wilted and their heads drooped.

lines.japanese: 「え、な、なに。なんでこの俺がイジめたみたいな構図になってんの」
lines.english: “Wh-what? How did I end up looking like the bully here?”

lines.japanese: 「Ｕｍｍ……だってよォ、皇帝は俺らを捨ててから引きこもっちまって、インターホン鳴らしてんのに返事も返ってきやしねェし」
lines.english: “Umm... 'Cause after the Emperor ditched us, he shut himself away. Won't even answer when we ring his intercom.”

lines.japanese: 「それに和馬も入院中でしょ？　あいつがいねーとコーダインも遊びに来ねぇし、なんつの、俺からすっとタメで話せる相手が二人も減っちまってよォ～」
lines.english: “And Kazuma’s still in the hospital, right? Without him around, Kodine doesn’t come hang out either. That’s two people I could talk to as equals, gone just like that.”

lines.japanese: 「ペガの敵討ちっつっても、あのオウムちゃん？　Ｒ－ウイングとは関係ないって言うじゃない。こっちも一人ボコってんし、手を出すワケにもいかないのよネ～」
lines.english: “We could avenge Pega, but that parrot—R-Wing, was it?—apparently had nothing to do with it. We already beat up one of theirs, so we can't exactly make another move.”

lines.japanese: なるほど、カケルくんは俺の人格が統合されたことで引きこもりに入っちゃったのか。
lines.english: So that was it. My personalities had integrated, and Kakeru had gone into seclusion as a result.

lines.japanese: 「そんで、そこに成田クンまでいなくなったら、俺らのソウルは萎びる一方だァ……」
lines.english: “And now Narita disappears too. Our souls got nowhere to go but shrivel up...”

lines.japanese: 「何も成田っちに頭になってくれって言ってるわけじゃないのよお？　でもさあなんっつうか、一緒にバカやれる友達が欲しいってそんだけなの」
lines.english: “We're not asking you to be our boss, okay? We just want a friend we can do stupid shit with. That's all.”

lines.japanese: 「なァなァ、遊んでくれよ隼人先ぱ～い！　とりまＹＦＢも仕切るやついなくてガタガタだし、ちゃけば隼人先輩しか俺らまとめられるヤツいないっしょ！」
lines.english: “Come on, play with us, Hayato! For now the YFB's falling apart with nobody running things, and straight up, you're the only guy who can hold us together!”

lines.japanese: 「ふーん……」
まあこいつらの言うことも分からないでもない。というより、これだけ慕われて悪い気になるはずがない。
lines.english: I could see their point. More importantly, being adored this much could hardly feel bad.

lines.japanese: ただまあ、残念だが……。
lines.english: Unfortunately for them...

lines.japanese: 「甘ったれんな」
lines.english: “Don't be such babies.”

lines.japanese: 俺は項垂れる三人に縦型チョップを一発ずつ落としていった。
lines.english: I brought a vertical chop down on each of their bowed heads.

lines.japanese: 「シット！」
lines.english: “Shit!”

lines.japanese: 「ラダマス！」
lines.english: “Radamas!”

lines.japanese: 「あいでっ！」
lines.english: “Ow!”

lines.japanese: 「俺は見ての通りお仕事中なんだよ。遊びたいならアポとってからきなさい」
lines.english: “As you can plainly see, I am at work. If you want to play, make an appointment first.”

lines.japanese: 「アポォ？」
lines.english: “An appointment?”

lines.japanese: 「そうそうお約束。基本だろ、基本」
lines.english: “Yes, yes. Set a time with me first. That's basic courtesy.”

lines.japanese: 俺は目潰しピースを三人に向けた。
lines.english: I aimed an eye-gouging peace sign at all three of them.

lines.japanese: 「大体勝手にカルテットに加えんなよ。俺は自由の翼、誰にも縛られない永世中立国だといつも言ってるだろう」
lines.english: “And don’t add me to your quartet without permission. I am the wings of freedom, an eternally neutral state bound to no one. How many times have I told you?”

lines.japanese: 「おまえらと愉快な仲間たちの面倒見られるやつなんか一人しかいないっつうの」
lines.english: “There's only one man alive who can look after you and your merry band.”

lines.japanese: 「その皇帝がいないんだってば～」
lines.english: “We told you, the Emperor isn't here.”

lines.japanese: 「だったらおまえらも卒業しなさい。いつまでも子供みたいな遊びをしてるんじゃありませんよ」
lines.english: “Then you boys need to graduate too. You cannot go on playing children's games forever.”

lines.japanese: 俺は持ち場の方を向いて立ちあがった。そろそろやつらが戻ってくる頃だ。
lines.english: I stood and turned back toward my station. The others would be returning soon.

lines.japanese: 「んだよ成田クン、冷てぇなあ」
lines.english: “Come on, Narita. That's cold.”

lines.japanese: 「待て、一度でも温かくしたことあるかのように言うな。元々おまえらに対してはこんなもんだ」
lines.english: “Wait. Don't talk as though I've ever treated you warmly. This is exactly how I've always treated you people.”

lines.japanese: 「仕方ないなあ、また来るからネ～」
lines.english: “Can't be helped. We'll come back another time.”

lines.japanese: 「来るのか！」
lines.english: “You *are* coming back!?”

lines.japanese: 一体こいつらは何を聞いていたんだろう。俺は頭が痛くなった。
lines.english: Had they heard a single word I said? My head began to hurt.

lines.japanese: でもなんとなく楽しい気持ちになったので、口元が綻んだのは内緒だ。
lines.english: Still, I was enjoying myself in spite of everything. Nobody needed to know about the smile tugging at my mouth.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあな。俺は仕事に戻るからおまえらもさっさと……」
lines.english: “See you. I'm going back to work, so you people hurry up and...”

lines.japanese: あ。
lines.english: Ah.

lines.japanese: 「ん？　どったの～？」
lines.english: “Hm? What's wrong?”

lines.japanese: そうだ。あいつらに何か用意しとけって言われたの忘れてた。
lines.english: Right. I had forgotten about whatever the workers told me to get ready.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あのさあ、おまえらの中に『らちぇっと』ってなんだか分かるやつ……」
lines.english: “Um, listen. Does one of you know what a 'ratchet' is...?”

lines.japanese: 「は？　そんなん知らねー方がおかしいでしょ。そこのレンチっすよ」
lines.english: “What? You'd have to be an idiot *not* to know. It's that wrench over there.”

lines.japanese: 「ど、どうもありがとうございます……」
lines.english: “Th-thank you very much...”

lines.japanese: 「じゃー、仕事がんばってくださいネッ！」
lines.english: “Well, good luck at work!”

lines.japanese: 「じゃ～ね～、成田っち～」
lines.english: “See you, Narita!”

lines.japanese: 「ピ～ス・ア～ウ！」
lines.english: “Peeace ouuut!”

lines.japanese: そしてやつらは疾風のごとく去っていった。そのあとすぐに、ここまでかと思うくらい絶好のタイミングでプリン頭たちが帰ってきた。
lines.english: And with that, they vanished like a gale. The pudding-heads came back almost at once, with timing so perfect it was ridiculous.

lines.japanese: 「おい、チンタラしてんなー、作業始めんぞ」
lines.english: “Hey, quit screwing around. We're getting back to work.”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 後半は真面目に仕事に打ちこむことにした。
lines.english: For the rest of the shift, I applied myself seriously to the job.
